gloss: Taira no Kiyomori (12th-century leader of the Heike)

definitions.explanation: The head of the Taira ({平家|へいけ}) warrior clan at the end of the Heian period. He was the first warrior to become Grand Minister of State, placed his grandson on the throne, and promoted trade with Song China. His clan was destroyed by the Minamoto four years after his death, a story told in the Tale of the Heike.
